agent.problem: Calling David "king of Israel" uses a fact that Psalm 6:1 does not state. The card gives no supporting reference for that outside-passage detail; it needs one, or David can be introduced without the title.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

agent.problem: The question says "After all those nights of weeping," but Psalm 6:6 says "all night" and does not specify multiple nights. This adds a time detail not established by the BSB text.

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
